roles.name: Crusader
powers: You may discard the top card of your deck to add 1d6 (☐+1) (☐+2) (☐+3) to your check. If the top card was a blessing (☐ or spell), recharge it instead of discarding it.
You may examine the top card of your location deck at the start (☐ or end) of your turn. If it's a boon, put it on the bottom (☐ or underneath the top card) of the deck.
☐ When another character at your location is dealt Combat damage, reduce that damage by 1.
☐ Add 1d8 with the Magic trait to your check to defeat a bane with the Undead trait.
☐ When you play the Blessing of Iomedae, you may recharge it (☐ or shuffle it into your deck) instead of discarding it.
